title: The shipped deployment compose inverts the code's fail-closed RBAC: public reads, owner-less, every authenticated key an Editor
evidence: The code fails closed — `public_reads_enabled() ends .unwrap_or(false)` (rbac_gate.rs:126-133) and main.rs:807,813 refuses to start owner-less unless `RBAC_ALLOW_OWNERLESS` is set. But docker-compose.unified.yml:111-112 sets `RBAC_PUBLIC_READS=1` and `RBAC_ALLOW_OWNERLESS=1` "with the :-1 default", so "an unassigned pubkey resolves to Editor (role_store.rs:359)" via `UserRole::default_authenticated()` (rbac.rs:68-70). VC-33.6 confirms the compose sets `RBAC_PUBLIC_READS=1` (cited at :106 after two block moves).
failure: Deploy with the provided compose: all `/api` reads (graph data, ontology, provenance reports, insights) are anonymous; anyone who installs a NIP-07 extension and logs in gets Editor and can mutate graph/settings state for every user. The Rust defaults and the shipped defaults are two opposite postures, and the operator who never reads the compose env block gets the open one.
marked_by_authors: yes (VC-22.9 "CORRECTED ADR-2070" note; called ADR-2027's "deliberate demo default and stays")

title: Agent-action ingest attributes events to pubkeys with no signature: provenance, KPIs and federation records are forgeable by any session holder
evidence: "SECURITY: ProvenanceStatus::Attributed means a well-formed pubkey was asserted, NOT that a signature was verified - the wire carries no sig field (provenance.rs:29-38)". The only gate on `/wss/agent-events` is a Bearer/session token (ingest.rs:257-294). These events feed `provenance::record` → `record_crossings` (provenance.rs:96-103), `kpi_agent_events` with `agent_did` (sqlite_kpi_repository.rs:334,245), Trust Variance and HITL Precision (kpi_compute.rs:98,140,143).

Nothing after ingest can distinguish real from forged actors.

title: Pod memory deletion never reaches RuVector: "deleted" agent memories stay searchable as embeddings, now with a second consumer

title: Erasure has no mechanism at all for the provenance graph: append-only invariant vs erasure duty is an unresolved proposal
evidence: "INVARIANT: append-only - no DELETE, DROP or CLEAR issued against this graph (ADR-2016, provenance_emitter.rs:32-33)"; "Retraction only ADDS dl:validTo and deletes nothing - history never removed (provenance_writer.rs:218,478-502)". The only escape is "PROPOSED ADR-2102" (crypto-shredding or declaring provenance out of scope) — a proposal that "exists to force that choice rather than leave it to omission", i.e. neither choice has been made.

title: Memory-cloud 401/403 is deliberately silent, contradicting the ADR-2108 principle that refusals are visible in the headset

title: Route ordering compares unrebased wall clocks: a skewed headset clock makes desktop routes permanently Stale

The headset's own queries stamp `sent_at` from the same local clock (`memory_route.rs:1596`).
